story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: We started from a simple frustration — watching small business owners pay for websites that don't bring them customers, or paying tens of thousands to design agencies and waiting months.
story.paragraph2: We built a system that gives every business a custom website — at a transparent price, fast, without compromising on quality. Our technology runs a team of AI agents working in parallel — so instead of months of work, you get a ready website in minutes.
story.paragraph3: We are our own first customer — we built this website through our own system to prove it works. What you're seeing right now was created automatically, end to end.

ctaBanner.title: Ready for a Website That Actually Works?
ctaBanner.subtitle: In minutes you'll have a custom premium website for your business

q1.question: How long does it take to get a ready website?
q1.answer: The website is built automatically within minutes of completing the questionnaire. After the system finishes, you receive a link to a ready website that you can review, request changes, and launch. The entire process is significantly faster compared to working with a designer or agency, where two months is still optimistic.

q2.question: What's the difference between you and a regular website builder?
q2.answer: Regular website builders give you a template you need to fill yourself — write content, choose design, tinker with settings. Our system does everything — researches your industry, writes customized marketing content in Hebrew, designs according to your business style, and builds the code from scratch. The result is a unique website, not a template with your logo.

q3.question: Can I edit the website after it's ready?
q3.answer: Absolutely. After the website is created you can request changes and customize content and design. Every website is built with clean, organized code, making changes simple and fast. If you need a content update, color change, or a new page — we're here.

q4.question: Does the website include accessibility?
q4.answer: Every website we build meets the Israeli IS 5568 accessibility standard and the international WCAG 2.1 AA standard. This includes a built-in accessibility widget with eight functions — text resizing, contrast, animation pause, large cursor, and more. Accessibility is a legal requirement in Israel, and with us it comes built into every website.

q5.question: What about Google ranking?
q5.answer: Every website is built with SEO from the ground up — custom meta tags, structured schema (JSON-LD), proper content structure, fast loading, and clean code that Google loves. This doesn't replace ongoing organic promotion, but it's an excellent starting point that gives your website a real chance to appear in search results.

q6.question: How does bilingual content work?
q6.answer: The system creates bilingual content — Hebrew and English. Every page includes content in both languages with a one-click switch. Hebrew is written in a direct, informal Israeli tone, and English is professional and adapted for international audiences. Hebrew support includes full RTL adaptation.

q7.question: Who is this service for?
q7.answer: Any small or medium business owner in Israel who needs a professional website. Restaurants, clinics, law firms, real estate agencies, contractors, fitness studios — whatever your field, the system knows how to adapt the design and content precisely to your niche. If you have a business and need a digital presence — this is for you.

accessibilityStatement.heading: Accessibility Statement | GelbIt - Premium Websites
accessibilityStatement.text4: GelbIt - Premium Websites is committed to making the website https://gelbit.co.il accessible to people with disabilities. We invest ongoing resources and effort to ensure that all users, regardless of their abilities, can browse the website, use its content and services in a comfortable, equitable, and respectful manner.
accessibilityStatement.heading6: This website complies with the following standards:
accessibilityStatement.heading7: Israeli Standard IS 5568 — Web Content Accessibility.
accessibilityStatement.heading8: WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines by the W3C.
accessibilityStatement.heading9: Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law, 5758–1998 and its regulations.
accessibilityStatement.heading11: The following accessibility features are implemented on the website:
accessibilityStatement.text13: All website elements can be navigated using the keyboard alone, including menus, forms, and buttons.
accessibilityStatement.text15: The website is built with semantic tags and ARIA labels to support screen readers.
accessibilityStatement.text17: A minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 between text and background, with an option for high contrast mode.
accessibilityStatement.text19: Text size can be increased or decreased using the accessibility widget.
accessibilityStatement.heading21: Motion and animations can be stopped for users who are sensitive to movement.
accessibilityStatement.heading23: Option to display an enlarged mouse cursor for improved visibility.
accessibilityStatement.text25: Option to display the website in grayscale for users with color sensitivity.
accessibilityStatement.heading27: Option to switch to a more readable system font to support dyslexia.
accessibilityStatement.heading29: Option to visually highlight all links on the website.
accessibilityStatement.text31: All images on the website have descriptive alternative text (alt) describing their content.
accessibilityStatement.text33: An accessibility widget is installed on the website and is available on all pages. It can be opened by clicking the accessibility icon (wheelchair) on the side of the screen. The widget allows personal customization of the browsing experience according to individual needs.
accessibilityStatement.text35: Encountered an accessibility issue? Please contact us and we will be happy to assist. We take every accessibility inquiry seriously and work to resolve issues as soon as possible.
